summary: This stage executed a replication unit across Tier 0 (static data audits), Tier 1 (monolingual directions and MWEAT), and Tier 2 (minimal alignment and debiasing). The agent successfully downloaded the MUSE vectors and reproduced the Spanish Original MWEAT (3.6918), verified that LDA achieves 0.9168/0.8275 while the notebook stores LinearSVC results, and proved that the published 0.389 cosine stems from an operator precedence bug in cell 36. However, it skipped the translation retrieval and Spearman correlation experiments, and it failed to identify the circularity of the mitigation evaluation, accepting at face value that Hybrid Ori reduces bias.
